country.evidence_quote: Initially established as a branch of the “San Pietro a Majella” Conservatory in Naples through the efforts of Maestro Vincenzo Vitale, the institution gained full autonomy and its modern campus during the crucial years of the post-earthquake reconstruction. Since then, the “D. Cimarosa” Conservatory has steadily grown into one of the largest and most prestigious institutions for Higher Artistic and Musical Education (AFAM) in Southern Italy.
